Mr. Arshad Shafi v. CACI Limited
1. Background
Under Section 8 of the Employment Rights Act 1996, employers are under a statutory duty to 
provide employees with an itemised pay statement for each pay period.
From 2001 to 2021, the Claimant received monthly payslips by post from CACI Limited. However, 
in 2021, these payslips abruptly ceased without explanation. The Claimant was left without payslips
or P60s for a period of four years (2021–2025), creating uncertainty over his pay, deductions, and 
tax status.
In August 2025, the Claimant formally requested copies of payslips and P60s from the Respondent. 
The Respondent subsequently admitted the omission and supplied retrospective documentation for 
the period in question.
